profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a public company headquartered in Miami, Florida, traded under the ticker HUT and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001964789. On its own site the company describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies, and says this portfolio provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The site also announces that Hut 8 has fully commercialized its 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, which it says brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion. That campus is the main AI-related item the company presents on its site.

Beyond the corporate registration details, the record notes litigation exposure in Florida, with a count of 88. No individual products or MCP servers are listed for the company.
